correctness.rationale: Centering removes the diffusing Brownian center of mass. Synchronous-noise coupling of two centered systems gives d/dt E||Z||²=−νN E||Z||²/2 from Σ_{i<j}(Zi−Zj)²=N||Z||², so W₂ contractivity yields a unique invariant law. A quartic Foster inequality LQ² ≤4D(N+1)Q−3ν(N−1)Q²/4 justifies fourth moments. Direct midpoint binomial identities produce LQ=2D(N−1)−νNQ/2, LP4=12D(N−1)Q/N+ν(3Q²−7NP4)/8, LQ²=4D(N+1)Q+ν[−(N−3/4)Q²+NP4/4]. This nonsingular linear stationary moment system yields exactly all displayed EQ, EQ², EP4. Exchangeability and Σ_{i<j}(Yi−Yj)^4=N P4+3Q² yield both distinct kurtosis expressions; differentiation proves strict N decrease and limits. The affine Q generator yields E[Q_t|Y0]=EQ+exp(−νNt/2)(Q0−EQ), hence the exact time covariance. All N≥2, D>0, ν>0 checked analytically; no stationary law claimed for uncentered positions.

value.rationale: Exact fourth moments and temporal correlations diagnose persistent non-Gaussianity of individual coordinates even when the normalized global gyration self-averages; the two different universal kurtosis limits and exact N-dependent relaxation provide a genuinely testable finite-size feature of a natural cooperative noise suppression model, not a routine variance reparametrization.

final_claim: In finite-N constant-unordered-pair-rate cooperative Brownian midpoint resetting, the centered process has a unique invariant law, explicit all-N stationary second and fourth moments, nonzero limiting local and pair excess kurtoses 6/7 and 3/7, self-averaging squared radius, and an exact exponential stationary gyration covariance decay rate νN/2.
limitations: Centered full-complete graph process, each unordered pair independent rate ν, N≥2 and D>0; uncentered center of mass is Brownian and not stationary. Exact kurtosis-limit ratios do not establish limiting full distributions, and no distance-dependent pair kernel is assessed.
